name: index_momentum_stock_selection_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY has established >0.5% return from the day's open by 10:00 IST, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing buy-side mandates (FII inflows, mutual fund SIPs deployed intraday) remain active through the morning session, absorbing short-term supply and creating a persistent directional bias. At 5-second resolution, this regime manifests as a drift where 2-minute counter-moves are quickly followed by resumptions — the institutional buy queue has not cleared. A bearish morning regime (NIFTY down >0.5% from open) creates the mirror dynamic with seller-driven TWAP flow overwhelming intraday bounces. We confirm the regime is still live with a 2-minute spot return aligned to the morning direction before entering, filtering dips/pops that temporarily break the regime.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY morning momentum regime (>0.5% from open by 10:00) confirmed by 2-minute aligned return for re-entry
